summary: Browse and read books from your calibre-web library.
page_description: Browse a public or private OPDS library, download EPUBs and continue reading offline.
release_notes: Browse real library catalogs, sign in on the reader, download EPUBs and keep reading offline with save recovery.

steps.text: Add the HTTPS OPDS address of your calibre-web or calibre content-server library.
Choose Sign in on the reader for a private library, or Use public library. Older named accounts should sign in again to bind the account to this server.
For a private certificate authority, install its trust root separately.
